private theorem closed_four_labels :
    (∀ a b c d : Fin 9,
    fourExponent a b c d 0 +
      (List.ofFn (fun q : Fin 8 => fourExponent a b c d q.succ)).sum + 8 = 12) ∧
    (∀ a b c d : Fin 9,
    (((fourExponent a b c d 0).factorial *
      factorialProduct (List.ofFn
        (fun q : Fin 8 => fourExponent a b c d q.succ)) : Nat) : ℤ) =
      kernel a b c d) := by
  decide +kernel

closed_first_certificate:
have hvalues : ∀ i : Fin 7,
      (unitExponent i 0).factorial *
          factorialProduct (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 6 => unitExponent i r.succ)) = 1 ∧
      unitExponent i 0 + (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 6 => unitExponent i r.succ)).sum + 6 = 7 := by
    decide +kernel
closed_second_certificate:
have hvalues : ∀ i j : Fin 7,
      (unitExponent i 0 + unitExponent j 0).factorial *
          factorialProduct (List.ofFn
            (fun r : Fin 6 => unitExponent i r.succ + unitExponent j r.succ)) =
        1 + (if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
      (unitExponent i 0 + unitExponent j 0) +
          (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 6 => unitExponent i r.succ + unitExponent j r.succ)).sum + 6 = 8 := by
    decide +kernel
